methodology: Research conducted via WebSearch using queries targeting market reports (Precedence Research, Market.us, Research and Markets, Technavio), peer-reviewed publications (arXiv/Google Research), practitioner sources (Lifebit, Tracebloc, Spheron), and regulatory analysis (Kiteworks, Fin.ai).
